evidence.title: Interpretable statistical feature engineering for early disruption prediction in the short pulse ADITYA tokamak

summary: Researchers developed an interpretable AI model using statistical feature engineering to predict plasma disruptions in the ADITYA tokamak, enhancing fusion reactor safety. The approach improves early detection, critical for stable tokamak operations.
title: AI Advances Early Disruption Prediction in ADITYA Tokamak Through Interpretable Feature Engineering
